title: ReLiveGym: Evaluating Long-Lived Agents over Weeks of Replayed Reality
abstract: arXiv:2610.00710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents become widely adopted, they are increasingly deployed for tasks that require persistent monitoring or recurring actions (e.g., market analysis). These agents are expected to operate unattended for days or weeks, act at the right timing, and adapt to the dynamic environment over time. These challenges are not fully captured in the existing long-horizon agent work, as they often consider a static environment that is not temporally changing. We introduce ReLiveGym, a diagnostic evaluation environment of long-lived tasks in which agents act sparsely over simulated weeks of chronologically replayed real-world news, market, and social-media streams. The tasks span diverse levels of time sensitivity, reasoning intensity, and recurrence. translated_title: ReLiveGym：在数周重放现实中评估长寿命智能体
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体被广泛采用，它们越来越多地被部署于需要持续监控或重复执行动作的任务（例如市场分析）。这些智能体被期望能够无人值守地运行数天或数周、在正确的时机采取行动，并随时间推移适应动态环境。这些挑战在现有的长时程智能体工作中并未被充分覆盖，因为它们通常考虑的是不随时间变化的静态环境。我们提出了ReLiveGym，一个针对长寿命任务的诊断性评估环境，其中智能体在按时间顺序重放的真实世界新闻、市场和社交媒体数据流构成的模拟数周时间中稀疏地采取行动。这些任务涵盖了不同水平的时间敏感性、推理强度和周期性。在八个基础语言模型上，我们研究了模型选择和框架设计如何影响智能体在此类长寿命任务上的表现。我们的结果显示，智能体如何检测……
tldr: ReLiveGym是一个面向长寿命LLM智能体的诊断性评估环境，通过按时间顺序重放数周的真实新闻、市场和社交媒体数据流，让智能体稀疏地执行跨时间敏感性与周期性的任务，从而研究模型选择与框架设计对其在动态环境中把握时机与持续运作能力的影响。
en_tdlr: ReLiveGym is a diagnostic evaluation environment for long-lived LLM agents that act sparsely over simulated weeks of chronologically replayed real-world news, market, and social-media streams, enabling study of how model choice and harness design affect performance on tasks requiring timing, persistence, and adaptation in dynamic environments.
